title.narrative: Public Financial Management Compliance League Table (PFMCLT) for Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (MMDAs) - Grant with CLGA

description.narrative: Contract related to: Public Financial Management Compliance League Table (PFMCLT) for Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (MMDAs) - Grant with CLGA - The Overall Objective (Impact) of this action is to improve financial and economic governance for an inclusive, greener and digitalised Ghanaian society and economy. SO1: Public Finance Management in Ghana is improved, more transparent and accountable, including social demand-side accountability through CSOs engagement with gender and green responsive budgeting in place. SO2: Private sector in Ghana is greener, digitalised and more inclusive (including in the creative and heritage, healthcare and pharmaceutical industries).
